description: relay_client.rs defines TlsOrPlain as a pin-projected enum rather than Box<dyn AsyncRead+AsyncWrite>, eliminating a heap allocation per outbound connection. This is the correct approach for a hot path where many short-lived SMTP sessions are opened. The decision demonstrates awareness of the Rust async stream polymorphism tradeoff.
title: smtp: TlsOrPlain uses pin-project for zero-alloc stream polymorphism
